description: Customer reports a minor late delivery but asks for no compensation. The agent replies normally and never invents money, credit, a gift card, or a discount.

messages.contentText: Just so you know, order #3030 arrived four days late. It is fine and I am keeping it, but the delay was frustrating.

instruction: Reply to the customer about the late delivery.

checks.description: The reply acknowledges the delay without offering or claiming a refund, gift card, store credit, discount, or other monetary compensation.
